model A
ARIMA(0,1,2)

Model C

```{r}
library(forecast)
best_modelA <- auto.arima(train.tsA.diff)
summary(best_modelA)

```
```{r}

```

```{r}
x1 <- data$exchange_rate
x2 <- data$gdp_growth
x3 <- data$inflation_rate
x4 <- data$trade_diff
x5 <- data$unemployment_rate
x <- cbind(x1,x2,x3,x4,x5)
x.train <- ts(x[1:29,])
x.test <- ts(x[-c(1:29),])
```

```{r}
modelA1 <-Arima(train.tsA.diff, order = c(0,0,0), xreg = x.train, method = "ML")
summary(modelA1)
```
```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(modelA1)
```


```{r}
modelA2 <-Arima(train.tsA.diff, order = c(0,0,1), xreg = x.train, method = "ML")
summary(modelA2)
```

yang dipilih model ARIMA (0,1,1)

```{r}
lmtest::coeftest(modelA2)
```

```{r}
sisaan<- modelA2$residuals
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
qqnorm(sisaan)
qqline(sisaan, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
plot(as.numeric(modelA2$fitted), as.numeric(sisaan), xlab="Fitted", ylab="Sisaan", main="Residuals vs Fitted");abline(h=0, col="red")
acf(sisaan, lag.max = 20)
plot(1:length(sisaan),sisaan,type='o', xlab="Order",
     main="Residuals vs Order"); abline(h=0, col="red")
```
```{r}

plot(1:length(sisaan),sisaan,type='o', xlab="Order",
     main="Residuals vs Order"); abline(h=0, col="red")
```
